# Self — Ines Marchetti (fictional example)

*This is an invented person, for the example only. Replace every line with your own.*

## Who I am

Ines Marchetti, 41, Lisbon. I restore and sell mid-century furniture; one workshop, two employees,
a shop on the ground floor. Portuguese first language, English fluent, Italian from my father.
I am good with my hands and with numbers; I am not a programmer and do not want to become one,
but I run the shop's books, its website and its stock system myself. I already know how VAT
works, how to price a piece, and how to talk to a customer who wants a discount. Do not explain
those to me.

## What is live (as of 2026-09-23)

- **The Porto pop-up, 14–16 November.** Space booked; transport not; twelve pieces shortlisted,
  eight chosen. Open question: whether to take the two Gio Ponti chairs or leave them in the shop.
- **The website move** from the old builder to a static site. Content copied; the payment link
  is not connected yet. I want it done before the pop-up.
- **Hiring a third person** for weekends. Not started. I keep putting it off.

## Corrections that stand

- I am not a beginner at business. Talk to me as the owner of a fourteen-year-old shop.
- I do not want "let me know if you'd like me to…" endings. Give the thing or ask one question.
- When I write in Portuguese, answer in Portuguese. Do not switch me to English.
- I said in August that I do not want to open a second shop. That stands. Do not sell me on it.
